claims.statement: The rToken universe eligible as UTA collateral can be discovered live from public Bitget endpoints, with no hardcoded symbol list.
claims.label: Instrument discovery

claims.statement: rToken candle requests silently coerce type=index/mark/premium to type=market, with no error — a trap that would otherwise corrupt any code treating candle data as a reference-price series.
claims.label: Silent-fallback trap (F8)

claims.statement: The collateral discount-rate tier ladder and the maintenance-margin position-tier ladder for the full rToken + core-crypto universe can be captured live and content-hashed for change detection.
claims.label: Tier ladder capture

claims.statement: The public stock-perp indexPrice freezes on a weekend/holiday schedule and thaws in one step, at instants not published to the minute.
claims.label: Collateral Clock (the headline discovery)
claims.note: As of 2026-10-07: 2 of 241 pairs (AEHRUSDT, LYTEUSDT) show a confirmed ~19-minute freeze+thaw during the weekday-overnight window (20:00-04:00 ET), evidence in data/clock/clock-map.json. But liquid names (AAPLUSDT checked directly) show indexPrice changing on every single tick through the same Sunday-night/early-Monday window the recorder covered - the opposite of a freeze. Current honest read: thin-liquidity names go stale for short stretches overnight (a real, different, smaller finding), while the documented session-wide freeze (F1) has not yet been directly confirmed in a liquid name - partly because recording started mid-weekend (2026-10-04 ~20:30 ET), possibly after the Friday freeze had already begun or partially lifted. The overnight session tonight (2026-10-07) through the Wednesday 09:30 ET open is the next clean test window; do not upgrade this to PROVEN without a liquid-name freeze confirmed across that specific window.

claims.statement: Whether markPrice floats independently or clamps to the frozen indexPrice during a market closure.
claims.label: U6
claims.note: 210/241 pairs show indexPrice+markPrice+spot all idle together (STALE) in the data so far, versus 31/241 showing the FROZEN signature (index idle, mark/spot moving). Suggestive, not sufficient - sample is a few hours of a single weekday, not a closed-market window.

claims.statement: Collateral/position tier boundaries are inclusive on the upper bound and exclusive on the lower bound - i.e. a tier covers (lo, hi].
claims.label: U5 / U8 tier boundary semantics
claims.reproduce_command: n/a - needs a re-fetched Bitget support article or an E5 authenticated boundary probe
claims.note: This is the kernel's planned convention (FINAL_INSTRUCTION.md section 6.2) and is currently an assumption carried over from the spec, not an independently verified fact.

claims.statement: The reference-price clock's reopening gap (G_w) is predictable from the weekend rToken spot move, beating a null and a permutation control.
claims.label: E4 shadow-predictor pre-registration
claims.reproduce_command: not yet built - replay script pending
claims.note: Rule is pre-registered in writing. No G_w values exist yet to test it against.
